page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a woodcut ornament band above the title and a large decorated initial opening the text. No margin notes. Signature mark "*2" printed at the foot of the column.

main_text.head: Nobilissimis & Amplissimis GYMNASII TETRARCHIÆ NEOMAGENSIS CURATORIBUS.
main_text.p: CAusaque me impulit cur vobis hoc opusculum leviden-se, inscribendum putarim, præter omnem expectationem se mihi obtulit & reperta potius

page.notes: The opening word is set with a large decorated initial "C"; it is read here as "Causa" with the initial joined to "Ausa" (printed "Aufa que me"). The line "Aufa que me" reads "Ausaque me" in the printed scan; the first letter is taken as part of the initial. Title lines are set in mixed capitals and spaced capitals; the first line is italic. Printed "Aufaque" is set as "Ausaque" in the spacing of the scan; a doubtful reading. Woodcut ornament band above the title is not text.
